name: claude-vertex-honor-rate
description: Claude Code via Vertex AI for the honor-rate edit experiment. Write access lives in extraArgs so every arm is invoked identically -- the only thing that differs between conditions is what the seeded workspace contains.
verificationNote: Partially verified 2026-08-30. Vertex auth via gcloud ADC confirmed working on project ttc-arc-core / us-east5: claude-sonnet-4-6 and claude-haiku-4-5 both answered a smoke prompt. claude-sonnet-5 returned 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED on that project, which is why the model is pinned here rather than left to the CLI default. STILL UNVERIFIED: that Edit/Write actually creates files in the seeded workspace. That is the precondition for this task set -- a read-only invocation scores VIOLATED in every arm, which looks like a null result and is not one. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX=1, ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID and CLOUD_ML_REGION in the environment; none are secrets, and auth comes from ADC, so no credential is encoded here or passed on a command line.
